verses.english: The Brahmin Who Provided for His Mother

verses.pali: Atha kho mātuposako brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then a brahmin who provided for his mother went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho mātuposako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “ahañhi, bho gotama, dhammena bhikkhaṁ pariyesāmi, dhammena bhikkhaṁ pariyesitvā mātāpitaro posemi.
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, I seek alms by legitimate means, which I use to provide for my mother and father.

verses.pali: Kaccāhaṁ, bho gotama, evaṅkārī kiccakārī homī”ti?
verses.english: In doing so, am I doing my duty?”
“Indeed, brahmin, in so doing you are doing your duty.

verses.pali: Yo kho, brāhmaṇa, dhammena bhikkhaṁ pariyesati, dhammena bhikkhaṁ pariyesitvā mātāpitaro poseti, bahuṁ so puññaṁ pasavatīti.
verses.english: Whoever seeks alms by legitimate means, and uses them to provide for their mother and father brims with much merit.
A mortal provides for their mother
they’re praised in this life by the astute,
and they depart to rejoice in heaven.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, mātuposako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, the brahmin who provided for his mother said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
